findings: RadixMap indexOf selects bits after least significant bit; scalar search visits only exact bucket. Original header control with radix1,query0,threshold2 returns hash4 but misses equally distance-one hash2 in another bucket. Radix0 scalar reference returns both. This is an intentional approximate search tradeoff disclosed in header, not full metric-radius recall.

Eight-query overload chooses bucket from queryHashes[0] for every query. Synthetic mixed-bucket queries miss an exact match for second query that scalar search finds. Video caller grouping invariant still unread: do not claim this is necessarily a real application batching bug.

Search appends to supplied match vectors and does not sort or clear them. Caller owns result initialization/order; behavior differs from VP-tree wrapper. Threshold is exclusive and stored as char distance_t; public search-parameter validation/caller conversion still needs review.

Constructor bounds radix by estimated bucket memory around1GiB, allocates pointer table eagerly and shares an empty Bucket until insertion. This estimate is not a total-memory budget or measured performance guarantee.
Header addressOf uses member access on bucket pointer with dot rather than arrow; template method not instantiated by these controls. No full-build failure claim; callers still unreviewed.
Stats sums allocated bucket capacity; empty-bucket treatment differs between memory/mean and sigma calculations. No timing/memory qualification or benefit claimed.

executed_controls.method: Original full RadixMap header with only hamm.h include replaced by builtin-popcount shim; clang++C++20 O2 and Qt macro/log shims. Bounded synthetic hashes/buckets; no native pHash, media, Qt runtime or ASAN.
